markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_World_Tree_Lift
markers.note: A living lift. It asks where you are going and sometimes disagrees.

markers.name: INT_Root_Market
markers.note: Shop stalls grown into the roots (Part II 38).

markers.name: INT_Grafting_Bench
markers.note: Combines two Organic weapons into one. Results are not always predictable.

markers.name: INT_The_Pollen_Tram
markers.note: Traverses the canopy on a schedule the city sets, not you.

markers.name: INT_Hive_Council
markers.note: NPC faction. They remember every interaction (GDD 18).

markers.name: INT_The_Wound
markers.note: A cut in the world-tree. Healing it changes the district's layout.

markers.name: INT_Sap_Vault
markers.note: Rare crafting materials behind a puzzle of growth cycles.

markers.name: INT_Seedpod_Elevator_Shaft
markers.note: Drops you to the roots. Coming back up is a separate problem.

markers.name: INT_The_Key_of_Roots
markers.note: One of three keys the CORE accepts (Part II 47).

markers.name: INT_Canopy_Bridge
markers.note: Grows across as you walk, retracts behind you.
